message.reasoning_content: George Martin produced Long, Long, Long. "Can You Dig It?" and "One After 909" and "Maggie Mae" were Glyn Johns? Actually Let It Be was Phil Spector—but George Martin didn't produce those. Long, Long, Long (White Album) — George Martin.
